home.heroTitle: Trusted job opportunities for our community, with full privacy
home.heroLead: Register your skills once and see the jobs that fit your experience. Employers contact you only after you express interest.
home.how1: Short steps that save automatically. Finish any time.
home.how2: Jobs are ranked by fit and marked suitable or near match.
home.how3: With your consent, the employer receives your profile and contacts you.
home.privacyBody: Employers only see your data after you express interest and consent. Employer identities are never shown on jobs, and every employer is reviewed by an admin before posting.

login.title: Log in
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Log in with the new password.
login.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Please log in again.

signup.title: Create a job seeker account
signup.lead: We will send a code to your personal email to activate the account.
signup.pwHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
signup.consentShare: I agree that my profile, CV and contact details are shared with an employer only when I express interest in their job.
signup.consentTerms: I agree to the terms of use and privacy policy.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.codeHint: The code is valid for 10 minutes. If you cannot find it, check your spam folder.
verify.verified: Your account is active. Welcome to Sanad.
verify.missingEmail: We do not know which email to verify. Sign up again or log in.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we will send you a code to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If this email is registered, a code will arrive within a minute.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Enter the code we sent to
reset.resend: No code? Send a new one

change.title: Change password
change.lead: Choose a new password for your account.
change.forcedNote: This is a temporary password. Change it now to continue; you will not be asked again.

seeker.title: My professional profile
seeker.placeholderTitle: The profile wizard is coming soon
seeker.placeholderBody: Here you will complete your personal details, dar and fakhdh, contact details, education and experience, and upload your CV.

employer.title: Employer dashboard
employer.placeholderTitle: The employer dashboard is coming soon
employer.placeholderBody: Here you will post jobs, follow interest requests and close jobs.
employer.signupSoonBody: Employer registration opens soon. You can already join as a job seeker.

admin.title: Admin overview
admin.placeholderTitle: The admin dashboard is coming soon
admin.placeholderBody: Counts of seekers, employers and jobs, pending approvals and the latest audit entries will appear here.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may have changed or the page was removed.
